MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_BLADE_BETWEEN.title: The Blade Between
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_BLADE_BETWEEN.descri:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Combo[/gold]: Gain {ComboBlock} more [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_SIGMUND_AVENGED.desc:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_FAFNIRS_HEART.title: Fafnir's Heart
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_FAFNIRS_HEART.descri:
This combat, if [gold]Gram[/gold] is your current sword at the start of your turn, draw {GramFafnirsHeartPower} additional card.
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (costs 0 from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_LAST_THROW.title: Last Throw
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_LAST_THROW.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If your HP is at or below half, deal it twice.
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).
